tag_sigma: start fix error; Isaac two-tag run: 1.5 cm median xy, 0.8 deg median yaw (sim/fiducial)
gyro_noise: BMI055 (D435i IMU chip) noise density from a Bosch forum post; the D455 chip is unconfirmed (research/step2/22-imu-noise.md)
gyro_bias: 1-sigma bias left after averaging the gyro at standstill; BMI055 offset drifts +-0.015 deg/s/K (Bosch forum, 22-imu-noise.md), so a few kelvin of warm-up
imu_hz: gyro rate used here (the sim step)
sub: time slices per L1 frame for motion skew
kiss_max_range: KISS-ICP max range; voxel = max_range / 100 (KISS-ICP default rule)
kiss_min_range: drop returns closer than this (L1 minimum range is about 0.05 m)
fuse_every: window over which LiDAR and wheel+gyro increments are fused
sig_win_lidar: lidar_gyro increment error over one window, measured on tuning arenas 1000-1003 (tune.py)
sig_v_wheel: slip variation within a window (SLIP_LEVELS sd)
wheel_cal_err: error of the BP-1 slip calibration: the run's true mean slip differs from the calibrated one by this 1-sigma (research/step2/23: flat-ground slip sd 0.03, Inferred)
wall_sigma: per-point wall residual used to turn the ICP fit into a covariance
wall_lam_min: weakest-direction information per point below which a fix is skipped
wall_min_pts: wall points needed for a fix
